name: conductor
description: Conductor orchestrator + 5 subagents (planning, research, implement, code-review, memory) and their MCP servers. Subagents work through the job-file protocol in .claude/conductor/job/; the orchestrator is the only agent that talks to you and the only one that dispatches memory, which keeps the project's .claude/agent-memory/conductor-main/ Obsidian vault. Run /baton:setup to enable the Task tools (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS) in the project's .claude/settings.json.
